props.caption: Bahrain and Qeshm. The documented sequence does not establish a Kuwaiti link.
Nvidia’s new board committee oversees national-security policy, export-control compliance and global trade risk management.
Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate and its deposit and lending facility rates.

lead.what: Iranian and U.S. accounts place the Bahrain drone attack before U.S. strikes on Qeshm; Kuwait reported hostile drones without an established connection.

rest.what: India identified MT Tara Gas after a fire off Musandam; UKMTO left the reported vessels unnamed and responsibility unattributed.

lead.what: Nvidia’s board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and established a national-security and export-control oversight committee.

rest.what: The White House withdrew Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination, so the scheduled Senate committee vote will not advance it.

lead.what: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6.00% and raised its deposit and lending facility rates.
